notes.title: Dragon Star Varnir™ Will Release A Day Early on October 8!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/d82c28f280533a4d61f5765f5e172f575e4e5833.png[/img]

[b]Awaken the Dragon within![/b] Previously it was stated that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/][b]Steam®[/b][/url] release of [url=http://ideafintl.com/varnir/][i][b]Dragon Star Varnir™[/b][/i][/url] will launch on [b]October 9, but now... the epic dragon RPG will be released A DAY EARLY on October 8, with a 20% weeklong launch discount[/b]!

Originally released on the PlayStation®4, the Steam version will include ALL gameplay and art content from the Japanese version, as well as English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

Upon launch, Steam users will be able to grab the[b] Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) at a permanent 10% discount[/b]. The [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] will also have a weeklong 20% discount and includes:​

[list]
[*] Character and Background Art Collection​
[*] Rough Art Collection​
[*] PC Wallpaper (x3)​
[*] Mobile Wallpaper (x6)​
[*] Soundtrack (12 tracks)
[/list]

Taking place in a world where witches are cursed to give birth to dragons, one man tasked with hunting them soon finds his own fate intertwined with his former enemies. Fight against dragons in turn-based, midair combat, using tiers, transformations, and more to weaken them and devour their abilities! The fate of three witches is in your hands – will you choose to save them or sacrifice them to gain items and skills? Your decisions will change the course of the game!​

Add Dragon Star Varnir to your wishlist today!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/[/url]

notes.title: 5.18.2018 Update
notes.notes:
Captains of the Special Force Valkyrie! We have great news! Our developers have implemented a patch to the build today which addresses the reported performance issues:

[list]
[*]Improved overall optimization to reduce hitches and lags.

[*]Added new graphic options to customize game performance.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and help with this issue. If there are other problems, please continue using the forums to search for possible fixes or submit the issues to our PC Support form [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]here[/url] to give us feedback directly!
